Implemented in e1908ed on `develop`: `fliesswerk check` loads, layers and validates the config (exit 0 valid, 3 invalid), and the JSON Schema is published as `schema/config.schema.json`.

Per-Harness settings live under `[harnesses.<name>]` (Spec #31 amended). Deferred: checking the `factory` semver pin, and deprecation warnings for renamed keys (none renamed yet).
